module: Grid selector backend for the LightRunner Vue wizard. It reuses the same levels/tracks as the quick race (scenario_quickRaceLoader): only the vehicle selection is restricted (powerglow-compatible car/truck), elsewhere in the vehicle selector's filters. The module simply copies into M all the functions of the backend created by `oneshotRaceSelector/core` with the descriptor `quickRaceTrackDescriptor.build("lightRunnerSelector")`.
notes: The exported functions are those built by createBackend (not listed in the auto page); this file defines nothing else except `dependencies`.
